THE ROLE As a Senior Full-Stack Engineer on the Media Team, you'll work across Solink's entire media pipeline. It starts with the software that runs on site next to customers' cameras and recorders in more than 36,000 locations. It ends with the AWS-native services that ingest, process, store and serve that media at scale. In between, video is captured, buffered and transcoded at the edge, sent over networks that are often limited or unreliable, and turned into something customers can search, watch and act on in the cloud. Most of your time will go into the cloud: building media managing/processing services, evolving media APIs, and tuning storage, networking and compute for cost and performance. A large share will also go into the edge: Rust and TypeScript software running on Linux and QTS-based devices, working within tight bandwidth, CPU and storage limits, and keeping thousands of remote devices healthy and up to date. Above all, you'll own the boundary between the two: the protocols, contracts and failure handling that make the pipeline reliable end to end. jobs.description_text: OUR MISSION SPAN develops products that accelerate the rapid adoption of renewable energy in the home. The flagship SPAN Smart Panel is the first true evolution for the traditional home electric panel, harnessing enhanced technology for metering, monitoring, and control. An expanded product suite of intelligent, integrated solutions radically lowers the cost and complexity of energy upgrades–including solar, batteries and EVs–empowering homeowners to be active, resilient and informed players in the energy market. THE TEAM AND ROLE SPAN's Device Software team is responsible for all of the software that is physically embodied in our hardware products. The Gen3 SPAN Panel is a distributed system of STM32H5 (Arm Cortex-M33) microcontroller modules that talk over CAN, meter power in real time, and open or close relays that sit directly between the grid, the home and its solar, battery and EV equipment. When that firmware makes a decision, real current moves. This is not a checkbox exercise: FuSa at SPAN spans how we architect and partition the firmware, how we detect faults and drive the system into defined safe states, how we test and prove coverage, and how we document and trace every safety requirement back to code. jobs.title: Member of the Technical Staff - Product Engineer
jobs.description_text: The Problem We’re Solving: A home’s survival in a wildfire or flood depends on its materials, geometry, topography, and defensible space. Traditional insurance models flatten that complexity, offering little insight to homeowners and few incentives for mitigation. Stand combines deterministic catastrophe models with modern AI to compute property-level risk and embed it directly into underwriting, pricing, and mitigation workflows. Instead of obscuring risk behind averages, we make it measurable and actionable - giving insurers sharper pricing signals and homeowners clear insight and incentives to mitigate. We build production software that connects scientific modeling to real-world insurance operations, turning physics into decisions. The Role: We’re hiring a Member of the Technical Staff - Product Engineer with engineering excellence - someone who has owned large product surfaces, navigated tradeoffs, and is comfortable being accountable for outcomes, not just implementations. This role is not narrowly scoped. You’ll own critical systems across the insurance lifecycle, from core workflows (policy, underwriting, claims, payments) to entirely new products like wildfire preparedness inspections, risk monitoring, and customer-facing mitigation tools. You’ll work closely with applied scientists, product leaders, and stakeholders to: - Translate complex domain problems into shippable systems - Decide what to build, not just how to build it - Productize models, pipelines, and tools

jobs.title: Storage Platform Engineer
jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE Supabase runs millions of Postgres databases, and storage performance is now one of the biggest levers on how fast, reliable, and affordable they are. We're building a software-defined, NVMe-over-Fabrics storage platform underneath Supabase Postgres. Postgres stays unmodified, and the new layer delivers near-local-NVMe performance with the durability and flexibility of networked storage. As the senior engineer driving storage, you'll own this effort end to end: the architecture and build-vs-buy decisions, integration into our compute platform, and operating the system in production. Your first goal is raw Postgres I/O performance at scale. In the longer term, the layer you build will provide the block-level snapshots and copy-on-write clones behind database branching, fast restores, and instant resizes.
